title_en: Amazon Prime Video's August Lineup Includes New Episodes of Reacher and More Zendaya
body_en:
The Rings of Power season 3 trailer and God of War recasting news may have been the biggest Prime Video announcements recently, but don't let those take away from another solid month of content. Amazon is bringing a slate of popular movies to the platform starting on August 1, followed by several originals, WNBA games, and Yankee games worth watching if you already have an Amazon Prime subscription.
We've highlighted some of the best things to watch on Prime Video this August, but if you're just looking for a detailed list of everything coming this month, you can jump to the full release schedule by day .
If you don't think you're getting enough Zendaya this year (she's in The Odyssey , Spider-Man: Brand New Day , and Dune: Part 3 ), you should definitely check out Challengers. It's a classic love triangle trope wrapped into a tennis movie that IGN's reviewer called "one of the sexiest and most electric dramas of 2024".
Although Challengers initially came to Prime Video back in 2024, it left the platform in late 2025 and hasn't been available to stream since.
Read IGN's 9 out of 10 review for more info.
Back in 1998, Small Soldiers was one of the coolest movies about action figures. The general storyline is that military AI microchips were accidentally placed into rival action figure lines and the toys get brought to life. If you haven't already seen it, it's absolutely worth a watch. And if you have already seen it, just how long has it been? This movie is a blast of nostalgia, and the recent 4K remaster last year only makes it better.
The latest Planet of the Apes movie has been out for more than two years now, but it's still a great film to watch if your a fan of the franchise. The story takes place a full 300 years after War for the Planet of the Apes after the apes have fully taken over human civilization and technology. In case you didn't already know, these movies are technically disconnected from the original Planet of the Apes timeline and can be watched without context from those movies.
Read IGN's 8 out of 10 review .
Alan Ritchson is returning for yet another season of the popular Jack Reacher series, and he's got plenty of punches left in him. Reacher's fourth season is based on the 13th book in Lee Child's series and is looking to be just as action packed as the first three seasons so far. In addition to these new episodes, Amazon also announced that a Reacher spin-off about Frances Neagley will be arriving in September as a follow up.
*This list may not be comprehensive and is subject to change throughout the month. Click through the links to check out IGN's original reviews.
Anyone who has an Amazon Prime membership will automatically have access to Prime Video. There's a 30-day free trial available for new subscribers as well as a 6-month free trial for students. That subscription will get you access to the Prime Video streaming library with ads, so you'll still need to pay a bit extra to go ad-free.
Amazon raised prices for its ad-free streaming tier earlier this year while . As of April 2026, you'll need to pay an additional $4.99 per month to remove the ads from your service.
Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics -- from TV series to books and the latest Pokémon games .
